name: Eager direct-wrapper versus registered-op diagnostic
registration: After initial full-grid eager regressions and before this component diagnostic
purpose: Separate the unchanged checked CUDA wrapper from the registered Python custom-op call path before deciding whether a native C++ Torch binding is warranted
accumulation: FP32, no lossy weights or reduced-precision BF16 reduction
measurement: Unchanged synchronized allocation-including bench_dispatch._eager; no monitoring during timing. Same physical packed buffers for both custom arms, same x and actual original weight bits for every arm.
numerics: Unchanged FP64 gate on all copies before and after timing, exact decoded weights, source/runtime/context hashes retained
interpretation: Diagnostic only. Compare registered_op with direct_wrapper and both with nativeTorch. Do not identify a particular CPU/driver cause from timing alone, promote an implementation, tune kernels or retrofit earlier failures.
